name: Shimeng Supply Chain Mgmt Co. Lt
summary: Headquartered in Beijing, China, Shimeng Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. (established in 2010 and formerly known as Shimen Logistics Holding Co., Ltd.) specializes in delivering bespoke, end-to-end logistics and supply chain solutions. The company's primary focus is serving multinational manufacturing enterprises operating across China. Its comprehensive suite of services includes outsourced contract logistics, overarching supply chain management, domestic freight transportation, port-related operations, international cargo forwarding, and extensive warehousing facilities.
